• Mahakavi Magha – 8th Century A.D.**
• Available in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam & Hindi**
• Select your preferred audio track from the settings menu!**
This episode beautifully explains that **true happiness in life comes from balancing family responsibilities with spiritual and intellectual growth**. Married life needs **sacrifice, understanding, and respect**, but it also helps in personal growth and practicing **dharma (righteousness)**. While money is important, the story teaches that **selflessness, knowledge, and service to others** are even more valuable.
